facts.text: Aspen University provides a Monthly Payment Plan structured as a private education loan with a 0% fixed interest rate (0% APR) and zero down payment.

sources.title: Payment Methods | Aspen University
sources.quote: The Monthly Payment Plan is a private education loan with a 0% fixed rate of interest (0% APR) and no down payment. Each month you'll make one payment of $325, $415 or $450
